collection.title: BYD Seal 6 2025 to 2026 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The BYD Seal 6 2025 Onwards model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Slim Push Button arm attachment.
